name: Dustling
description: A fluffy puff of rust-colored grit that rolls along crater floors. It sneezes tiny dust devils when startled.
scout_tip: Hold still and hum. Dustlings are drawn to steady sounds.

name: Whirlgrit
description: Dustlings that grow up spinning. They race the afternoon dust devils across Gale Crater for fun.
scout_tip: Scan it while it is spinning clockwise. It slows down right before it changes direction.

name: Tempestorm
description: When a Tempestorm gets angry, it can grow into a storm that covers half the planet for weeks.
scout_tip: Never approach during storm season. Scan from inside a shelter with the long-range lens.

name: Frostmite
evolution_trigger: Hold an Ice Shard at night
description: A tiny six-legged critter that sips CO2 frost. It hides in cracks when the sun comes up.
scout_tip: Shine a red light, not white. Bright light scares it away.

name: Glaciapod
description: A slow, gentle giant whose shell is made of thousands of layers of ice, one for every Martian winter it has lived.
scout_tip: Count the ice rings on its shell to guess its age. Most are older than the first Mars rover.

name: Rustbeak
description: A flightless bird that pecks iron out of rocks. Its beak turns redder as it gets older.
scout_tip: Keep metal tools in your pack. Rustbeaks will try to snack on them.

name: Oxiraptor
description: A fast hunter with armored iron plates. It glides on storm winds to chase prey across the highlands.
scout_tip: Only scan with a ranger present. Back away slowly if it fans its plates.

name: Glimmerwisp
description: A floating crystal that glows with starlight it saved up during the day. Often seen above the old river delta.
scout_tip: Turn off your helmet light. It will come closer to share its glow.

name: Lakewarden
description: Legends say it guarded Jezero when the crater was a lake. It sleeps beneath the delta and dreams of rain.
scout_tip: It only wakes for scouts who have scanned every other creature in Jezero.

name: Spindleroot
evolution_trigger: Planted near buried ice for 30 sols
description: A fungus-like creature that sends thin roots down to buried ice. It barely moves, but it is always listening.
scout_tip: Easy scan, but watch your step. Stepping on a root makes it puff spores.

name: Sporeweald
description: A grown Spindleroot that becomes a mini forest. Smaller creatures hide under its caps during dust storms.
scout_tip: A good place to wait out bad weather. Say thank you on the way out.

name: Cinderkit
description: A playful cub with glowing paws. It keeps warm by napping on old lava vents.
scout_tip: Its paws are hot enough to scorch gloves. Use heat-rated gear.

name: Calderion
description: Its back is covered in cooled lava plates. It guards the warm vents on the slopes of Olympus Mons.
scout_tip: Do not stand between a Calderion and a heat vent.

name: Olympyre
description: The king of Olympus Mons. When it stirs, the whole volcano glows. Some say it IS the volcano.
scout_tip: Scan only from the observation deck. This is an Arrow of Light challenge.

name: Echolurk
description: It copies the voices of other scouts to lure you deeper into the canyon. It eats echoes.
scout_tip: Use the buddy password. If a voice cannot say it, it is an Echolurk.

name: Canyonmaw
description: A huge burrower that tunnels through canyon walls. Its yawn can be heard 50 km away.
scout_tip: If the ground starts to hum, move to higher ground.

name: Rimglider
description: A kite-shaped flyer that rides warm air rising out of Valles Marineris. Flocks of them look like floating sails.
scout_tip: They love to race. Run along the rim and they will follow.

name: Mazelight
description: A little sprite that feeds on curiosity. It leads scouts in circles, then giggles in their radio.
scout_tip: Follow it only if you have dropped beacons. It always leads back to the start eventually.

name: Labyrinthos
description: The keeper of Noctis Labyrinthus. It is said to move the canyon walls at night. It weighs nothing at all.
scout_tip: It answers riddles with riddles. Bring a good one.

name: Fogwhisper
description: Made of morning fog. It whispers softly and disappears when the sun gets high.
scout_tip: Scan right at sunrise. You have about 20 minutes.

name: Sphinxshell
description: A crystal tortoise that sits so still it looks like a rock. It wakes only to test travelers with puzzles.
scout_tip: Answer its puzzle correctly and it lets you scan it for free.

name: Facewatcher
description: A shy sprite that shapes shadows on rocks into faces. It may be why the Face Mesa looks the way it does.
scout_tip: Smile at the rock faces. Facewatchers copy your expression.

name: Mesamole
description: A busy digger that leaves tunnel maps under the mesas. Scouts use its tunnels as storm shelters.
scout_tip: Follow fresh dirt piles to find one.

name: Basinback
description: A giant turtle that soaks in salty seeps at the bottom of Hellas. The thicker air here lets it stay warm.
scout_tip: Very slow and very friendly. Perfect for a first Bear-rank scan.

name: Perchloroach
description: A small bug that lives in perchlorate salt. Its shell is mildly toxic, so never touch one with bare hands.
scout_tip: Wear gloves and wash your suit after scanning.

name: Hellashound
description: A fast, dog-like creature that can smell a dust storm three sols before it arrives.
scout_tip: If a Hellashound starts howling, head back to base.

name: Frostowl
description: A silent owl that sees in the dark polar night. It is said to know the way home from anywhere.
scout_tip: Hoot twice and wait. It answers scouts who are patient.

name: Geyserling
description: In spring, it rides CO2 gas jets that burst out of the ice cap, launching dark dust into the air.
scout_tip: Visit in early spring when the geysers are most active.

name: Spiderfrost
description: Its legs carve spider-shaped patterns into the ice. From orbit, its webs look like giant cracks.
scout_tip: Do not walk on the dark spider patterns. That is its hunting ground.

name: Plainstrider
description: A tall grazer that travels in herds across Utopia, licking ice-rich soil for minerals.
scout_tip: Approach the herd from downwind and they will not stampede.

name: Permafang
description: A large wolf-like hunter with iron-hard fangs. It guards the buried ice of Utopia Planitia.
scout_tip: Stay inside the lit perimeter after dark. Permafang avoid bright lamps.

name: Lavaloon
description: A round, floating creature full of warm gas. It bounces down the slopes of Elysium Mons.
scout_tip: Do not pop it. It just floats away, annoyed, and you lose your scan.

name: Elysiarch
description: A winged guardian that greets every sunrise from the slopes of Elysium. Its feathers store sunlight.
scout_tip: Arrive before dawn and watch quietly. It appears only to respectful scouts.

name: Craterhopper
description: A long-eared hopper that can jump from one small crater rim to the next in a single bound.
scout_tip: They hop in straight lines. Predict the next crater and wait there.

name: Ventvine
description: A vine that grows around warm cracks in the dark basalt. It blooms bright orange flowers once every Mars year.
scout_tip: Look for orange glows in the dark rock fields.

name: Basaltle
description: A beetle with a shell of black volcanic glass. It rolls into a ball when scared.
scout_tip: Wait for it to unroll. Rolling it yourself is against the Scout Code.

name: Phobling
description: A small shadow creature named after Phobos, which means fear. It is more scared of you than you are of it.
scout_tip: Speak calmly. Loud voices make it vanish.

name: Stickneyx
description: It feeds on the tiny gravity ripples of Phobos and can leap between moon and planet in a single jump.
scout_tip: Tether yourself before scanning. Its jumps can pull you off the surface.

name: Argentail
description: A fox-like creature with a tail of frost crystals. It shines silver at dawn along the rim of Argyre.
scout_tip: Its tail reflects light. Look for silver sparkles at sunrise.

name: Rimwarden
description: A tall crystal sentinel that stands on the mountains ringing Argyre. It shields smaller creatures from storms.
scout_tip: Bow before scanning. It returns the bow and stands still.

name: Areonyx
description: No scout has ever completed a scan. Sightings report a red glow that moves between all regions of Mars.
scout_tip: Rumored to appear only after every other entry is complete.
